Turmeric Powder Wholesale Price for Bulk Buyers

Turmeric powder is bought in bulk by spice blenders, curry and noodle makers, beverage brands and private label packers. Tradenest Naturals offers fair turmeric powder wholesale price options for these buyers, as well as for exporters and spice traders. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers in India. The dried rhizomes are cleaned, fine milled and sieved to a steady 80 mesh. Ask us for a quote on turmeric powder price per kg, samples, packaging and export delivery. We supply turmeric powder in bulk with flexible specifications. Our standard grade is turmeric powder 80 mesh. In addition, we can discuss turmeric powder supplier requirements, private label packing, and customer-specific documentation. Our team reviews each inquiry according to the required grade, destination market, order size, and packaging format.

Product Overview

Turmeric powder comes from the dried rhizomes of Curcuma longa. It provides a warm aroma, earthy taste, and characteristic yellow to orange-yellow colour. Food manufacturers use it as a spice, colouring ingredient, and formulation component. Therefore, it fits many products without complex processing. Tradenest Naturals supplies turmeric powder for domestic and international B2B markets. We support standard bulk orders, distributor programs, OEM packing, and private label projects. We plan raw material purchases ahead for repeat customers and larger contracts.
  • Indian turmeric powder for food and ingredient applications
  • Standard 80 mesh particle size for smooth blending
  • Natural spice profile with no added colour in the standard product
  • Bulk and customized packaging for domestic and export supply
  • Batch-based quality checks and traceability documentation

Manufacturing and Processing

First, we select mature turmeric rhizomes from trusted growers in Indian growing regions. Next, we clean the raw material to remove soil, stones, and other foreign matter. We then dry the rhizomes under controlled conditions to reduce moisture and protect the natural spice profile. After drying, the turmeric is fine milled on food-grade equipment. The ground material passes through a controlled sieve to achieve the selected mesh size. For the standard grade, we target turmeric powder 80 mesh. Finally, we inspect the batch, pack it in moisture-resistant materials, and label it for traceability. Some buyers ask about spray dried turmeric powder for applications that need a different powder format. This is a separate product with its own carrier and formulation choices. Please share your process conditions so we can tell you what is possible.

Typical Technical Specifications

The following values describe the standard commercial grade. Actual limits may vary by crop, season, destination regulations, and agreed purchase specification. We confirm the final specification before production and dispatch.
  • Mesh size: 80 mesh
  • Moisture: ≤ 10%
  • Processing: fine milled
  • Appearance: fine yellow to orange-yellow powder
  • Flavour: warm, earthy, mildly bitter, and characteristic of turmeric
  • Added ingredients: none in the standard additive-free grade
  • Foreign matter: controlled according to the agreed food safety specification
  • Packaging: food-grade, moisture-resistant, and export-suitable formats
A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. If you need curcumin content or other analytical values confirmed for your market, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Please list these requirements before quotation.

Quality Standards and Documentation

Our quality process begins with raw material selection and continues through packing. We follow documented operating procedures for cleaning, drying, grinding, sieving, inspection, and storage. In addition, we maintain batch identification to support product traceability. Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. Customers receive the product specification sheet, batch information, packing details and the commercial documents for each shipment. If your importing country asks for specific certificates or reports, tell us at the inquiry stage. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We confirm what can be provided before making a commitment.

Applications

Turmeric powder supports both traditional recipes and modern industrial formulations. Its colour, aroma, and spice character make it useful in dry and wet systems. Also, its fine particle size helps manufacturers achieve even distribution during mixing.
  • Seasoning blends, curry powders, spice mixes, and masala products
  • Instant noodles, soups, sauces, gravies, and ready-to-cook meals
  • Namkeen, snack coatings, savoury bakery products, and fried snacks
  • Pickles, chutneys, marinades, and processed food recipes
  • Beverage blends, golden milk mixes, and herbal preparations
  • Private label spice products and retail turmeric packs
  • Food premixes, traditional Ayurvedic formulations, and custom ingredient systems

Buyer Value

Wholesale buyers need reliable quality, practical pricing, and predictable supply. Our turmeric powder helps streamline production because it arrives ready for weighing and blending. Moreover, bulk sourcing can reduce handling work and improve procurement efficiency.
  • Cost efficiency through bulk purchasing and scalable supply planning
  • Consistent 80 mesh powder for repeatable mixing performance
  • 24 months shelf life when sealed and stored under suitable conditions
  • Flexible pack sizes for distributors, manufacturers, and private labels
  • Export support with traceability and shipment documentation review
  • Custom specifications for texture, packaging, and application needs

Packaging and Shelf Life

We pack the product in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Packaging helps protect the powder from humidity, contamination, light, and physical damage. Standard options include 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg packs. We can also discuss bulk bags, export cartons, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, and custom printed packaging. Shelf life is 24 months from the manufacturing date when the product remains unopened and stored correctly. The final shelf life depends on the agreed product specification and packaging system. Each package can carry the batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, storage instructions, and required regulatory information.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Quotation Process

What is the minimum order quantity at turmeric powder wholesale price? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. Buyers can begin with a small trial and scale up once the product is approved. Private label packaging and OEM projects need extra planning for artwork and materials. Lead time is confirmed with each quotation, once specification, artwork and payment terms are approved. Export orders may need additional time for packaging and documentation. Therefore, buyers should share the destination country, required quantity, mesh size, packaging, and target delivery date. To request a sample or quote, send your company details and purchase requirements. Please include your target turmeric powder price per kg, annual volume, delivery location and any documents your market requires. We then review the request and send a clear commercial and technical proposal. Samples are available on request.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals operates as a manufacturer, wholesale supplier, exporter, and food ingredient development partner. We support food processors, FMCG brands, restaurants, importers, and distributors. In addition, our capabilities include grinding, sieving, blending, private label packing, and custom formulation. As a turmeric powder manufacturer India buyers can evaluate, we focus on clear specifications and responsive communication. As a bulk turmeric powder supplier India customers can use for repeat sourcing, we also support practical packaging and export planning. Above all, we aim to build long-term supply relationships through careful quality checks, transparent information and consistent service.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the standard particle size?

Our turmeric powder is 80 mesh, which blends smoothly in dry mixes and sauces.

Can you supply private label turmeric powder?

Yes. We offer OEM and private label packing in a range of pack sizes. Share your artwork and label requirements for review.

Can you supply spray dried turmeric powder?

Spray dried turmeric powder is a separate product, and we can discuss it on request. The final formulation depends on carrier, solubility, application, and regulatory needs.

What storage conditions apply?

Store the sealed product in a cool, dry, clean place. Protect it from sunlight, moisture, heat, and strong odours.

How can I obtain a current price?

Send quantity, mesh, packaging, destination, and delivery terms. We will calculate the applicable turmeric powder wholesale price and share a quotation.
